source.event_summary: Owner-submitted Kevin Warsh remarks and their possible BTC market impact.

horizons.trigger: Observe DXY, US 2Y/10Y yields, BTC spot and perpetual basis, OI, funding and liquidations for aligned risk contraction; then check whether the September hike probability rises above the event-time estimate and whether BTC breaks its pre-event range.
horizons.invalidation: The bearish research case fails if yields and DXY reverse, BTC reclaims the pre-event range without long-side stress, later inflation or labor data weaken the inflation-first narrative, or hike pricing falls.
